messages:
Marta: quick update — OptKit delivery status. PRs: quant-recs (#452) is merged to staging but we saw a perf delta on 2 small workloads. Batching/caching changes are in draft (@Jamie owns). Need to confirm canary plan.

Jamie: thx. can you paste the perf diff? is it latency p99 or tokens/sec?

Marta: p99 up ~18ms on long-tail (seq=1024) when kv-cache warmed; tokens/sec unchanged. snippet:
```
baseline p99: 58ms
quant-recs p99: 76ms
```

Ryan: that's probably kernel selection fallback. I left a note in #452 — added a flag `optkit.use_heuristic_kernel=true` for staging to test. Also blocked by infra dep: runtime-image v1.9 (needs merge). ETA EOD.

Sasha: fyi, ran evals against our regression-suite, saw 3 prompts with decoding mismatch (topk influence). logs:
`decode_mismatch: prompt_id=93, seed=42, diff=0.12` 

ci-bot: build/optkit-staging #128 failed — integration tests: decode-mismatch-suite. https://ci.internal/128 :x: 

Jamie: I can pick up the canary matrix tomorrow. @Ryan can you add the runtime-image PR link? also want to shadow 10% traffic first.

Ryan: PR link: https://git.internal/runtime/pulls/812. Will add canary config and rollback rule.

Marta: action items:
- @Ryan merge runtime-image PR + enable kernel flag in staging (blocked)
- @Jamie prepare canary matrix + traffic shadow (10% -> 25% if stable)
- @Sasha run focused evals on the 3 failing prompts and open a tiny repro
I'll follow up EOD. :thumbsup:
